english.title: Landlord / licensor with superior interest of HMO act without a section 61(1) licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(1)(b) and (6) of the Housing Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
landlord under a tenancy or
licensor under a licence to occupy
with an estate / interest / right in relation to the HMO
that was superior to the estate / interest / right of a person in section 72(1A) in relation to a HMO that was required to be licensed under Pt 2 of the Housing Act 2004
but was not so licensed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 72(1)(b), it is a defence that, at the material time- did not know, and had a reasonable excuse for not knowing, that the building or part of the building concerned was an HMO, took all reasonably practicable steps to ensure that the HMO was licensed under this Part, or had some other reasonable excuse for failing to ensure that the HMO was so licensed.
(ii) For an offence committed prior to the 1st May 2026, see H15307.
